document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, p.6, §2.2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: RATE.TIME is Unix seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The authenticated SoLEXS tools package is consistent with this conversion but does not add a GTI endpoint contract.

document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, p.5, §2.1.2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: RATE.COUNTS is counts per second in 2-22 keV.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This does not establish a physical irradiance or flux conversion.

document_filename_version_section_page: solexs_tools-1.1 README, CLI solexs-genspec and solexs-genmultispec sections
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The official tool requires the L1 GTI file for spectral generation, establishing that it is an applicable companion artifact.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No authoritative START/STOP units, relation to RATE.TIME, endpoint closure, malformed-interval, or overlap rule is supplied.

document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, pp.5-6, §§2.1.2-2.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: L1 light-curve RATE is associated with day-wise SDD1/SDD2 product directories and named detector products.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The release update does not define a general version-precedence rule.

phase4e_supported_interpretation: Daily release since July 2025 and historical data/software versions are documented; the 2025-02-14 update aligned timestamps to UTC and the 2025-04-05 pipeline update changed Date-obs, Date-end, MJDREFI/MJDREFF keywords.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: CREATOR, DATE, OBS_ID field definitions and complete product-version/configuration compatibility are not specified.

document_filename_version_section_page: solexs_tools-1.1 README, CALDB section and bundled CALDB/arf/solexs_arf_SDD2_v1.arf plus CALDB/response/rmf/solexs_gaussian_SDD2_v1.rmf
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The authenticated official package supplies SDD2 ARF/RMF calibration artifacts for spectral analysis.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: Neither the package nor the manual supplies a direct audited light-curve counts/s-to-irradiance/flux conversion, response selection rule, or uncertainty prescription.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Level-2 Processing Package V07, cli.py: validate_time_format, isot_to_mjd, mjd_to_isot; User Guide p.2 confirms L1 event-list input
phase4e_supported_interpretation: Officially supplied processing code constructs MJD with astropy Time(..., format='mjd', scale='utc') and converts UTC ISOT to MJD.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No L1 SIS explicitly declares the stored light-curve MJD time-reference metadata or a mismatch/disagreement policy; no production conversion is authorized.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Level-2 Processing Package V07, cli.py: validate_time_format, isot_to_mjd, mjd_to_isot; User Guide pp.1-2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: Officially supplied processing code validates ISOT using UTC and maps it to UTC MJD.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No Level-1 SIS states whether ISOT or MJD controls when stored values disagree, nor defines an allowed tolerance or rejection action.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 (January 2025), pp.51-52, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: CTR is count rate in cts/sec for documented light-curve extensions.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No conversion to irradiance is implied.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 (January 2025), p.51, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: STAT_ERR is uncertainty on count rate with cts/sec unit.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The manual excerpt does not define a more specific confidence or propagation policy.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 (January 2025), pp.5, 13, 51-52, §§2.1 and Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: Detector paths and LC extensions identify CdTe1/2 and CZT1/2; default broad bands are documented.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This does not establish current product-version precedence or calibration equivalence.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 (January 2025), p.13, Level-1 product description
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The four Level-1 GTIs span the entire dump and are relevant only to Level-2; the manual says they can be ignored for Level-1 analysis.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This is a Level-1 use policy only; it supplies no endpoint or Level-2 inclusion convention.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Release Notes, pp.4-5, Data Release 2 and Data Release 3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The release notes require regenerated Jul-Sep 2024 release-2 products instead of release-1 products, and warn of CZT event-list gaps in Dec 2023-Jun 2024.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The official note does not map V111/V211 identifiers, state a precedence for the observed February 2026 counterparts, or define cross-version calibration compatibility. Do not merge/select counterparts.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Release Notes p.2; HEL1OS User Guide for Level-2 Data Processing pp.2-3; HEL1OS Level-2 Processing Package V07 cli.py reject_series/build_page_diagnostics
phase4e_supported_interpretation: Official materials identify CdTe pile-up and CZT bunched-pixel counters as inputs to proxy live-time/effective-exposure processing and label SEP intervals as diagnostic rather than exclusionary.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The release notes say peer-review recommendations and high-count-rate testing are still being incorporated. No L1 flag/bit dictionary, saturation threshold, sentinel policy, or approved row-rejection rule exists; do not filter production data.
